value_stream.name: Global Mobility, Immigration & Foreign Worker Compliance

fields.Participants: Payroll (VS-19.2), Treasury/FX (VS-18.3), Comp (VS-102), Tax (VS-79), assignment-payroll vendor (W4700)
fields.Trigger: Assignment start; payroll cycle; mid-assignment change

workflows.name: Assignment Payroll, Multi-Currency & Home/Host Split-Pay Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Assignment-payroll configuration; multi-currency/FX automation; split-pay reconciliation
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: split-pay per package; FX from governed source (VS-18.3); reconciled across entities; SoD
Cross-references: - links to VS-19.2 (payroll), VS-18.3 (FX), VS-72 (intercompany), W4699 (package), W4714 (tax)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Split-pay-error risk**: Home/host split mis-computed → under/over-payment and intercompany distortion; mitigated by the package configuration and reconciliation
- **FX-volatility risk**: Multi-currency pay exposed to FX; mitigated by Treasury FX coordination (VS-18.3)
System Touchpoints: - Payroll (VS-19.2); treasury/FX (VS-18.3); intercompany (VS-72); comp (VS-102); assignment-payroll vendor
Time Estimate: - ~per cycle absorbed in payroll; ~per assignment setup 2–3 days

steps.activity: Set up the assignment pay structure: home-country pay vs. host-country pay split (per the package W4699), multi-currency, and the home/host entity payroll feeds (VS-72); configure in payroll (VS-19.2) and the assignment-payroll vendor
Run assignment payroll each cycle: home and host components, FX conversion (VS-18.3), allowances (premium, COLA, hardship), and tax/equalization entries (W4714); reconcile split-pay across entities
Manage mid-assignment changes (package, currency, entity), year-end reconciliation, and hand-off to repatriation/localization payroll (W4718); ensure SoD and audit trail

fields.Participants: Tax (VS-79), Payroll (VS-19.2), Treasury (VS-18), assignment-tax vendor, foreign worker, BIR
fields.Trigger: Assignment start/each tax year; tax filing; residency change

Automation Opportunity: - Residency/treaty decision support; equalization calculator; tax-filing automation
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: residency/treaty determined (Tax-led); equalization per policy; filings and records retained (VS-88)
Cross-references: - links to VS-79 (tax/BIR), W4697 (policy), W4713 (payroll), W4715 (statutory), VS-88 (records)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double-taxation risk**: Assignee taxed in both jurisdictions without treaty relief → cost and inequity; mitigated by treaty application
- **Equalization-error risk**: Equalization mis-computed → assignee/employer cost disputes; mitigated by documented methodology and annual settlement
System Touchpoints: - Tax (VS-79); payroll (VS-19.2); treasury (VS-18); assignment-tax vendor; records (VS-88)

steps.activity: Determine each assignee's tax residency (Philippine resident vs. non-resident; home-country residency), apply tax-treaty relief where applicable, and the 19-series (final withholding on non-residents) vs. regular graduated tax treatment

Operate tax-equalization (the assignee bears home-country tax as if at home; BuildRight bears/recoveres the host-country up/downside) or tax-protection per policy (W4697); compute the equalization settlement annually
File the assignee's Philippine tax (BIR — resident or 19-series non-resident W4715) and coordinate home-country filing/relief; retain tax records (VS-88) and support BIR audit (VS-79)

fields.Participants: Benefits (VS-102), Payroll (VS-19.2), Legal (VS-100.3), SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG, home-country schemes
fields.Trigger: Assignment start; statutory cycle; home-country continuity

workflows.name: Assignment Statutory Benefits, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG & Home-Country Continuity

Automation Opportunity: - Statutory-enrollment automation; totalization/certificate tracking; continuity alerts
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: PH statutory enrolled where eligible; home-country continuity managed; double-contribution avoided
Cross-references: - links to VS-102 (benefits), VS-19.2 (payroll), W4714 (tax), W4718 (assignment end)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double-contribution risk**: Statutory contributions in both jurisdictions without totalization → cost; mitigated by certificate-of-coverage where available
- **Coverage-gap risk**: Home-country scheme lapsing during assignment → assignee harm; mitigated by continuity management

steps.activity: Enroll the assignee in Philippine statutory benefits (SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG) where eligible (residents/9G holders); manage contributions via payroll (VS-19.2) per VS-102 statutory remittance
Maintain home-country social-security continuity (totalization/certificate-of-coverage where a treaty exists) to avoid double contributions and coverage gaps; coordinate home-country scheme
Manage statutory benefits on assignment end (W4718 — repatriation or localization); retain records (VS-88)

Automation Opportunity: - Relocation/housing workflow; vendor coordination; welfare-standard checklist
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: housing per package and welfare standards (VS-144); settling-in supported; cost within budget
Cross-references: - links to VS-144 (accommodation), W4699 (package), VS-83 (OH), W4710 (dependents)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Substandard-housing risk**: Assignment housing below welfare/safety standards → assignee harm and duty-of-care breach; mitigated by VS-144 standards
- **Cost-overrun risk**: Housing/relocation cost exceeding budget; mitigated by the package and approval matrix (W4699)
System Touchpoints: - Accommodation (VS-144); relocation vendor; OH (VS-83); HR (VS-19); records (VS-88)

steps.activity: Arrange assignment housing (company-leased vs. allowance, per package W4699; links to VS-144 staff accommodation for options), relocation (moving, storage), and settling-in services

Support settling-in: local registration, banking, healthcare enrollment (VS-83), schooling (dependents W4710), and community/spousal-support info; manage the housing lifecycle (lease, maintenance, exit)
Manage housing/relocation cost within budget (W4699); ensure housing meets welfare/BFP/OSH standards (VS-144); retain records (VS-88)

fields.Trigger: Assignment lifecycle; engagement cycle; wellbeing concern

Automation Opportunity: - Assignment-engagement pulse; check-in scheduling; EAP referral workflow
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: assignment objectives and check-ins; EAP/OH support accessible; feedback captured
Pain Points / Risks: - **Engagement-failure risk**: An isolated/unsupported assignee underperforms or returns early; mitigated by check-ins and EAP/OH support
- **Family-wellbeing-blind risk**: Family distress ignored → assignment failure; mitigated by family-wellbeing monitoring

steps.activity: Manage assignment performance and engagement: clear assignment objectives and success metrics, regular check-ins (HRBP + manager), and integration support (host team, culture)
Monitor assignee and family wellbeing (adjustment stress, isolation) and provide EAP/OH support (VS-83); intervene early on engagement/wellbeing concerns
Capture assignment feedback; feed lessons into mobility policy (W4697) and package/relocation improvements; manage underperformance or assignment failure

fields.Participants: HR (VS-19), Immigration (PA-160.2), Tax (VS-79), Payroll (VS-19.2), Treasury (VS-18), Legal (VS-100.3)
fields.Trigger: Assignment end-date; localization decision; early termination

Automation Opportunity: - End-of-assignment checklist; immigration exit-clearing workflow; financial-settlement automation
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: exit-clearing complete; final pay/tax/housing settled; localization/repatriation per policy
Cross-references: - links to W4706 (visa exit), W4713/W4714/W4715 (financials), W4699 (localization package), W4720 (ROI)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Exit-immigration-lapse risk**: Visa/I-Card not cancelled/surrendered cleanly → overstay/blacklist; mitigated by the exit-clearing checklist
- **Localization-injustice risk**: Localization offered on unfavorable terms → inequity/dispute; mitigated by the comp framework (VS-102) and clear communication

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Plan the assignment end: repatriation (return to home country/role) vs. localization (permanent host-country conversion with local package W4699); manage immigration exit-clearing (W4706), visa cancellation/I-Card surrender, and dependent-visa closure
Administer end-of-assignment financials: final pay (VS-19.2), tax settlement/equalization true-up (W4714), relocation back-home, housing exit (W4716), and statutory-benefit disposition (W4715)
Capture assignment outcomes and ROI (W4720); manage localization onboarding to the local package/entity or repatriation re-onboarding (VS-19); retain records (VS-88)

fields.Participants: Legal (VS-100.3), Compliance (VS-22), HR (VS-19), immigration agent (W4700), BI/DOLE
fields.Trigger: BI/DOLE inspection; notice of violation; penalty

workflows.name: Immigration/DOLE Inspection, Audit Defense & Penalty Management

Automation Opportunity: - Audit-evidence binder (W4711); findings/penalty tracking; root-cause workflow
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: audit-ready (W4711); violations Legally defended; root cause remediated; records retained
Cross-references: - links to W4711 (document tracking), VS-100.3/VS-100 (legal), VS-22/VS-21 (compliance/audit), W4703 (risk)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unprepared-inspection risk**: Documents missing at inspection → finding/penalty; mitigated by audit-readiness (W4711)
- **Officer-liability risk**: Immigration/labor officers carry personal liability for violations; mitigated by compliance and Legal defense

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Prepare for and manage BI/DOLE inspection: produce the alien registry, AEP/visa/I-Card records, employment contracts, and justifications (W4711); coordinate the inspection response

Defend against alleged violations (overstay, undocumented work, displacement); manage penalty assessment, appeal, or settlement per Legal (VS-100.3); protect officers from personal liability where possible

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Remediate the root cause (process, vendor, calendar W4703); retain records (VS-88); feed lessons into mobility-risk (W4703) and assure via Internal Audit (VS-21)

fields.Participants: Finance/FP&A (VS-17.4), People Analytics (VS-103), CHRO, CFO, Strategy (VS-33)
fields.Trigger: Periodic reporting; assignment-end ROI; leadership review

Automation Opportunity: - Mobility analytics/ROI dashboards; assignment-outcome capture; cost-vs-value models
Controls: - CTL-712 (ensure controlled execution — Assignment Administration, Tax/Payroll, Repatriation & Analytics (PA-160.3).)
- CTL-712: outcome-oriented analytics; ROI computed per assignment; reported to leadership; informs talent decisions
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4/VS-103 (FP&A/people analytics), W4699 (cost), W4718 (localization), VS-123 (local talent), VS-33 (strategy)
Pain Points / Risks: - **ROI-blindness risk**: Assignments continued without ROI evidence → wasted spend; mitigated by ROI computation and the localization review (W4718)
- **Vanity-metric risk**: Activity metrics without outcome/ROI → false assurance; mitigated by outcome-oriented analytics
System Touchpoints: - Mobility analytics; FP&A (VS-17.4); people analytics (VS-103); assignment-record (W4702); strategy (VS-33)

steps.activity: Maintain mobility analytics: assignment cost (actual vs. budget W4699), cost-per-assignee, localization rate, transfer retention, assignment-success/business-outcome, and KRIs (W4703)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / CHRO / CFO
steps.activity: Compute assignment ROI (business value delivered vs. total assignment cost) at assignment end and aggregate; identify cost-optimization and policy improvements (localization W4718, package benchmarking VS-102)
Report to leadership (CHRO/CFO/Strategy VS-33); feed into workforce planning (VS-103) and the make-vs.-buy talent decision (foreign assignee vs. local development VS-123)
